snippet.title: Simian Shakespeare - One Bard, Infinite Monkeys! Idle Game out now!
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4313120/Simian_Shakespeare/

One Bard. Infinite Monkeys. Hire apes to type at random until Shakespeare appears. Starting with a monkey pecking one character at a time, and scales all the way up to hundreds of monkeys hammering away and even a Monkey on your GPU typing millions of characters a second! Will they fill the book?
